newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to hike oil prices by 50 centavo/litre.
newsitem.headline: Manila to hike oil prices by 50 centavo/litre.

text.p: The Philippines' Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) will raise prices of most petroleum products on Tuesday by 50 centavos per litre, ERB chairman Bayani Faylona said.
Faylona told Reuters in a telephone interview on Tuesday that the adjustments will be announced at a press conference at 12 noon (0400 GMT).

ERB sources said it will be the biggest increase since partial deregulation was started in August and a monthly interim automatic oil price formula was implemented to pave the way for full deregulation next year.
Faylona said the increase is a result of the ERB's suspension of the oil price hike for the month of November which will be passed on this month.
He said Singapore Posted Prices, the benchmark for adjustments in domestic pump prices, have also been increasing.

The board announced last month the deferment of the oil price hike for November to seek the opinion of the Department of Justice on the validity of the formula and the oil price hikes. The move was planned following complaints by a member of the legislature that the oil price hikes were not justified.
But Faylona said the ERB had decided against seeking the opinion of the Justice Department.
